mapper.select: SELECT monthly_pick_id, member_id, pick_month, roastery, source_url, created_at FROM monthly_pick WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY pick_month DESC, monthly_pick_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_pick (member_id, pick_month, roastery, source_url) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{pickMonth}, #{roastery}, #{sourceUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT option_id, monthly_pick_id, raw_text, origin, producer, variety, process, dark_roast, decaf, sold_out, already_purchased, score, score_reason, created_at FROM monthly_pick_option WHERE monthly_pick_id = #{monthlyPickId} ORDER BY score DESC, option_id ASC
